name_note: Anaerobutyricum was created by reclassifying Eubacterium hallii, so most of this genus appears in older papers under the name Eubacterium hallii.

sentences.text: Anaerobutyricum was proposed when Eubacterium hallii was reclassified, together with the new species Anaerobutyricum soehngenii, whose type strain came from infant faeces.
The genus is one of the butyrate-producing groups of the human colon within the Clostridium cluster of Firmicutes.
A phase I/II study gave oral Anaerobutyricum soehngenii to people with metabolic syndrome and reported it safe, with fecal abundance correlating with peripheral insulin sensitivity.
Reviews list Anaerobutyricum hallii among candidate next-generation probiotics that have shown promise in preclinical models of obesity.
